_note: Library index. One entry per topic, in display order. The slug is the permanent address /hub/<slug>/ that the Client Hub links to: it comes from the Slug property in Notion, never from the title, and must never change. A topic's full content lives in /content/topics/<slug>.json. arms: ["all"] shows the topic to every member; otherwise list arm slugs.
